title: Term lock: one name per concept across abstract, demo and code
outcome: A glossary that fixes one public name per concept so the abstract, diagram, demo and contracts never use two words for one thing
acceptance: Covers at least: envelope, read/write set, gateway, recorder, witness, verify, lineage hold, graded containment (suspend/revoke/release), taint-scoped revert, re-run vs replan, root candidates, oracle S*, R and C, TTI-detect/attribute, TTC
Each entry: locked term, one-line plain-English gloss a banking reader understands, banned synonyms, and matching code/contract identifier where one exists
Maya confirms every code identifier matches contracts C1-C6 (or flags the mismatch)
summary: abstract/TERMS.md: ~65 locked terms in 6 tables (actors/path, record/audit, classes+containment, recovery, metrics, demo). Each row: locked term, gloss <=15 words for a banking reader, code name from C1-C6/module list, banned synonyms. All acceptance terms covered. Key locks: 'suspend' (not quarantine), 'lineage hold', 'record' (not log), 'taint-scoped revert', 're-run' vs 're-plan', 'root candidates' (not culprit/root cause), 'kill switch' = project name only; R/C metric-vs-class overload rule. Sec 7 lists 9 contract gaps for maya: revert vs C5 'restore'; Alert.suspect vs culprit; no contract for provenance graph, witness checkpoint, side store, hold window/sensitive tag, metric field names, idempotency_key; Control.target must accept a connection id (D7); reconcile detector name.
review:
[maya · changes] CHANGES (maya), mechanical. The coverage, glosses and banned lists are good, and so are the 'kill switch' and R/C rules. The code names were taken from maya.md §3, not from the frozen contracts 1.0.0, so these rows need fixing:
- culprit: there is no Alert.suspect. Use RunConfig.culprit (C6, scorer-only) and RecoveryPlan.culprit (C5, chosen by a person). The suspect is derived as root_candidates[0] (PMO accepted) and is never stored. Add a row 'suspect (console/internal only)', banned in the abstract.
- alert: fields are {alert_id, tick, seq, detector, kind, hard, evidence_seqs, evidence_versions, root_candidates, conn_id}; drop suspect. Alerts are not signed (Controls are), so drop 'signed' from the gloss.
- envelope: expiry_tick, not expiry; add claimed_ts_us/claimed_seq. The recorded form is EnvelopeHeader (args -> args_hash). act chain = act_chain: ActLink{principal, action_id}.
- tick: the barrier runs in the gateway (ADR-00), transport TickFrame. ks.runtime only spawns processes.
- read set = ReadEntry(obj, ver, hash). action class = action_class/ActionClass, not 'class'. Fix all 5 class rows.
- witness = C2 WitnessCheckpoint(seq, tick, head [+count, CON-02]), witness.jsonl.
- verify / tamper-evident: ks.verify.Exit + VerifyReport.first_bad (a seq, not an 'index') + last_witnessed_seq.
- reconciliation: AlertKind.RECONCILE, detector 'reconcile', Exit.RECONCILE, state_digest (C3).
- side store: C3 SideStore/SideEntry, run dir sidestore/.
- outbox: C3 OutboxItem (status queued/held/released/dispatched/cancelled) + C2 outbox_ids.
- lineage hold: also Decision.HOLD/Reason.LINEAGE_HOLD and OutboxStatus.HELD.
- hold window: RunConfig.hold_window_ticks. sensitive field: RunConfig.sensitive_fields ('table.field'), rule p.sensitive_early_hold, reason sensitive_field.
- invariant detector: AlertKind.INVARIANT, ids inv.* (ADR-04). taint = TaintSet (RecoveryPlan.taint_set). The dry-run diff field is RecoveryPlan.diff (DiffEntry); CLI ks recover --dry-run.
- write-write conflict: flag with reason write_write_conflict (pending the ADR-05 decision on restore-and-rerun).
- release gloss: the epoch is fresh, not rewound (SEC-03 B3). Suggest 'restores the agent's permissions (fresh epoch)'.
- t0: scorer uses RunConfig.fault_tick (CON-02, proposed); planner uses RecoveryPlan.t0_seq (estimate).
- metrics: tti_detect/tti_attribute/ttc match ADR-06, so remove the warning marks. post_alert_tainted and irreversible_(tainted_)released differ between ADR-06, ADR-04 and SPEC; tara decides, and TERMS copies the score.json keys exactly.
§7 answers: 1 confirmed, restore stays, revert = the set of restore steps (C5 docstring). 2 no suspect field, see above. 3 confirmed, no graph type. 4 resolved, WitnessCheckpoint C2 / SideStore C3. 5 resolved, RunConfig. 6 tara. 7 resolved, OutboxItem.idempotency_key + idempotency_key(). 8 resolved, Control.target conn:<id>. 9 confirmed, reconcile, class U.
Proposed additions: ACCEPT all three. idempotency key code = C3 OutboxItem.idempotency_key (it exists, it isn't proposed). workspace = workspace/state.db (C6 STATE_DB), ks.state.
Missing: add 'connection' (C2 conn_id, Control target conn:<id>). The anti-framing claim depends on it.
